meta.title: Toolpika Admin
meta.description: Content and request management for toolpika.site.

login.title: Sign in to the dashboard
login.description: Sign in with the admin email and password stored in Supabase Auth.
login.errorGeneric: Could not sign in. Check your email and password and try again.
login.errorForbidden: This account does not have admin access.
login.errorMissingConfig: Supabase is not configured. Add the Supabase keys to the Vercel project environment and redeploy.

common.errorSlug: The slug may only use lowercase letters, numbers and single dashes.
common.confirmDelete: Delete this permanently? This cannot be undone.
common.name: Name
common.title: Title

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: What is happening on toolpika.site right now.
overview.topToolsEmpty: Usage is not tracked for public tools, so this chart stays empty until a tool records real runs.

tools.title: Tools
tools.subtitle: Every tool that has a public page.
tools.name: Name
tools.empty: No tools in the database yet.
tools.iconHint: Lucide icon name, for example FileText.
tools.deleteConfirm: Delete this tool? Its page will stop resolving.
tools.deleteBlocked: This tool is still in the public registry file, so deleting it here only removes the database copy.

requests.title: Inbox
requests.subtitle: Tool requests and contact messages in one place.
requests.statusNote: Changing a status does not send an email. Reply from your own mail client so the message is one you control.

blog.title: Blog
blog.subtitle: Guides and articles.
blog.seoTitleOk: Title length is between 30 and 60 characters.
blog.seoDescOk: Description length is between 70 and 160 characters.
blog.seoHeadingsOk: The post has an H1 and at least one H2.
blog.seoHeadingsMissing: Add an H1 and at least one H2.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Measured numbers only. Nothing is tracked about the people using the tools.
analytics.trafficEmpty: Language and country are not tracked. Toolpika does not collect visitor data, so there is nothing to chart here.
analytics.privacyNote: Public tool runs stay in the visitor's browser. Toolpika never receives them, so tool usage charts stay empty on purpose.

pipeline.title: Autonomous Pipeline Control
pipeline.subtitle: Research, generate, verify and translate tools from one place.
pipeline.triggerDescription: Leave the topic empty to let the backend research what is trending right now.
pipeline.statusDescription: The most recent runs reported by the backend.
pipeline.queueDescription: Tools waiting to be translated into every available locale.
pipeline.noRuns: No pipeline runs yet. Trigger one above to get started.
pipeline.backendDownHint: The pipeline service could not be reached. Check the deployment and try again.

studio.title: Tool Studio
studio.subtitle: Chat with an assistant that knows every live tool and spec. Research an idea, generate real tool code, QA it, translate and publish.
studio.ideaPlaceholder: e.g. a tool that counts syllables in a sentence
studio.noSessions: No sessions yet. Start one above.
studio.chatDescription: The assistant sees the live tool inventory and the most relevant ToolSpecs on every turn.
studio.messagePlaceholder: Describe a tool, paste a competitor URL, or ask for the next step...
studio.actionsDescription: Each step saves its result to the draft. Run them in order.
studio.draftEmpty: No draft yet. Research and plan a tool first.
studio.backendDownHint: The Studio service could not be reached. Check the backend deployment.
studio.codeNote: Code is generated as a browser-only function. Apply writes it into the frontend checkout; publish stores the spec in Supabase.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Site details and the keys this deployment uses.
settings.siteUrlHint: Used for canonical URLs, the sitemap and robots.txt.
settings.keysHint: Only the status of each key is shown. Values are never sent to the browser.
settings.themeHint: Visitors can still switch theme. This is only the default for a first visit.

setup.title: Supabase is not configured
setup.body: The admin dashboard needs a Supabase project. Copy the example environment file and fill in the two public keys:
setup.command:
cd frontend
cp .env.example .env.local
# then set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
setup.after: Run the SQL in backend/database/ against the project, then promote your account with:
setup.promote: update public.profiles set role = 'admin' where email = 'you@example.com';

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: That admin page does not exist.
